howto.name: Upload PDF(s)
howto.text: Drop one or many PDFs up to 500 MB each. Multi-file batches are supported.

howto.name: PrivaTools removes all metadata
howto.text: Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Producer, Creator, Creation Date, Modified Date, all XMP fields, and any custom-defined metadata. The cleaned XMP keeps just two entries that the PDF library writes itself: a pikepdf producer tag and the time of processing.

howto.name: Download the clean PDF (or ZIP)
howto.text: Single file → single PDF; multiple files → ZIP. Visible content is unchanged.

faq.a: Author / producer / original-filename fields can identify who created or owns a document — a privacy concern for whistleblowers, journalists, or before public release.

It is not removed. EXIF inside images embedded in the PDF is left as it is: in a test, the camera make stored in an embedded JPEG was still in the output. Only the document's own Info and XMP metadata is cleared.

faq.q: Is this the same as Sanitize?
faq.a: No — Strip Metadata removes informational fields, including XMP. Sanitize clears only the document Info fields and Movie and RichMedia (Flash) annotations; it leaves JavaScript, embedded files and XMP in place.
